Control Statement: Conditional Access policy enforces multi-factor authentication for all users accessing cloud applications.
Phishing-resistant authentication is required for all privileged role activation and finance system access.
Privileged directory roles are assigned as eligible only with approval, justification and time limit on activation.
Segregation of duties conflicts in finance entitlements are detected and reported quarterly.
Internet-facing vulnerabilities rated critical or high are remediated within defined SLA.
Endpoint detection and response is deployed and reporting on all corporate endpoints.
IT and operational technology networks are segmented to prevent lateral movement.
Simulated phishing is conducted quarterly with targeted follow-up training.
Cloud resource configuration is continuously assessed against a defined secure baseline.
Critical services have documented and tested cross-region failover.
Cloud consumption is monitored against budget with alerting and quota enforcement.
Personal data retention periods are technically enforced and evidenced.
Data residency is enforced through platform region restrictions on all regulated workloads.
Master data is validated automatically against defined quality rules before reporting.
Critical suppliers are subject to documented due diligence at onboarding and annual reassessment.
Contingency and exit plans exist and are tested for each critical technology supplier.
Every AI system in production is registered with a named owner and documented authority boundary.
Use of unapproved external AI services is technically blocked and monitored.
Workload identity permissions are inventoried, owned and reviewed against least privilege.
Consequential AI-generated output requires documented human review before action.
All production changes follow the approved change process with rollback defined.
Technology assets are tracked through lifecycle with end-of-life remediation planned.
Backup restoration is tested at defined intervals and results evidenced.
Regulatory notification triggers are embedded in the incident management process.
Control operation evidence is centrally retained and available for customer assurance.
